en.title: StandTall, the posture support that reminds you to sit up straight

en.lede: A lightweight brace that pulls your shoulders gently back, so you notice when you slump and settle into a taller, more confident posture. Breathable straps, adjustable fit, and thin enough to wear under a shirt.

en.b1d: A steady, comfortable reminder that draws your shoulders back so you notice when you slump.
en.b2d: Straps adjust to your body, snug or relaxed, so it feels right whether you are at a desk or moving around.

en.q1: How do I choose a size?
